description:
[Trading Data API] Deribit volatility: DVOL implied-vol index (30d forward) + latest realized volatility, for BTC or ETH.

**Example:** `/v1/volatility?currency=BTC`

Use when you want Deribit implied volatility (DVOL) next to realized volatility for BTC or ETH. Not for other assets or ATR-style sizing (use atr).

Behavior: read-only. Priced via x402 (USDC on Base) or free with WICKEDAPI_API_KEY; with neither, you get HTTP 402 with the decoded price in payment_required (a price quote, not a failure).
name: volatility
